notes: Year-only file: the page states the year rule in text (positions 2-3, digits after the leading letter) but the month-letter mapping lives only in the nomenclature chart image, which text fetch cannot read, so no month is encoded rather than guessed. Month mapping is an image-pass item (see report). Related brands Aspen Pro and AirMark are listed on the page as related brands; sharing of this serial system is NOT verified, so they are listed as sisters in the page-fact sense only and no usesStylesOf is claimed. Company founded 1975 per page history.

styles.notes: Page example shown as 'J 04-0001762'; normalized (spaces/dashes stripped) it is J040001762. Page positions 2-3 (1-based) = year digits, converted to 0-based half-open [1,3]. Page position 1 (letter) = month, but the letter-to-month mapping is chart-image-only, so month is null here. Expected year 2004 is derived from the year digits under the century rule (1904 is below the 1960 floor), not page-stated.
